title: Design: Pays for window lists each customer as a link with Close
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer.
  • Start on customer A's page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-18-after-pays-for-list.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A window opens titled "[customer A's name] pays for" with an x at the top right.
  • Its grey line reads "These customers bill new work orders and part sales to [customer A's name] by default."
  • Customer B shows as an underlined blue link in a bulleted list.
  • A grey "Close" button sits at the bottom right.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R9: “Clicking the counter opens a window titled "[customer] pays for", listing each customer A to Z as a link to its page; a long list scrolls inside the window.”
  • S1-R10: “The window shows the line "These customers bill new work orders and part sales to [customer] by default." and a "Close" button.”
